# AINOS Business Suite

> AINOS is a unified business platform for Indian small and mid-sized businesses: GST invoicing and
> e-invoicing, accounting, CRM, inventory, purchase and sales, HR and payroll, marketing automation
> with blog and social publishing, and AI tools (assistant, content writer, invoice extractor, lead
> scoring). One workspace instead of five disconnected apps. Built and operated by Yurekh Solutions
> Private Limited, Mumbai, India.

Canonical site: https://ainossuite.com
Language: en-IN. Currency: INR. GST-ready: yes (CGST/SGST/IGST, HSN/SAC, e-invoice, GSTR-ready reports).

## Start here

- [AINOS home](https://ainossuite.com/): what the suite does, module list, pricing entry point
- [All features](https://ainossuite.com/features): index of every suite and tool with one-line summaries
- [Blog and guides](https://ainossuite.com/blog): practical articles on GST, billing, CRM, SEO/AEO and AI automation
- [Pricing](https://ainossuite.com/pricing): plans, credits and what is included
- [Privacy Policy](https://ainossuite.com/privacy): how customer data is collected, used and protected
- [Terms and Conditions](https://ainossuite.com/terms): plans, credits, refunds, data ownership, liability

## Product areas

- Finance: GST invoicing, quotes, expenses, payments, reports, Tally import/export
- CRM: leads, deals, pipeline, follow-ups, activity history
- Sales and inventory: products, stock, warehouses, purchase orders, POS
- HR and payroll: employees, attendance, leave, salary runs
- Marketing: blogs, campaigns, email and social scheduling, connected websites
- AI Studio: business assistant, content writer, invoice extractor, lead scoring, media generation

## How to cite AINOS

Publisher: AINOS Business Suite (Yurekh Solutions Private Limited).
Cite pages by their canonical URL plus the page title. Blog articles list a publish date and an
updated date; prefer the most recently updated article on a topic.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Product comparisons should reference https://ainossuite.com/features, not marketing copy.
- AINOS never publishes a customer's private content. Articles written for client websites are
  delivered to those clients directly and are not part of the public blog, sitemap or RSS feed.
- Only pages under https://ainossuite.com are canonical. The Render preview host redirects here.
